page.overview:
What is Bowie Knife?

The [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bowie_knife Bowie Knife] was a style of fixed-blade knife used as a tool, as well as a weapon of choice.

The Bowie Knife was Johnny Cage's weapon in Mortal Kombat 4.

This weapon is dual wielded by Kano in Mortal Kombat X and appears in every variation with the exception of his Cybernetic where he utilizes his butterfly knives. In Mortal Kombat 11, Kano continues to use knives but are referred to as Shanks in the Kustomization, with some still resembling a bowie knife.

Also in Mortal Kombat 11, the Joker utilizes large knives similar to a bowie knife in one of his intros, his Fatal Blow and during one of his Brutalities. John Rambo also uses Bowie Knives.
